item.title: Sid Seixeiro is back on the air covering sports in Toronto
item.description: Sid Seixeiro is officially back on the air.After teasing a return to the airwaves over the past few days, Seixeiro announced on Monday morning that he is launching the "Sid Seixeiro Show," a brand-new podcast focused on Toronto sports. item.title: Canadians will soon need a new visa to travel to the U.K.
item.description: Canadians who want to go on a food crawl in Borough Market or admire art at the Tate Modern will be required to obtain a United Kingdom (U.K.) Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) soon.The U.K. government announced in November that it would begin strictly enforcing the new visa waiver system starting on Feb. 25, 2026. item.title: Toronto Blue Jays finally removing controversial statue of former billionaire owner
item.description: The Toronto Blue Jays are changing up the look outside of Rogers Centre and removing a much-talked-about statue of the team's former billionaire owner. After announcing plans for a Joe Carter statue to be installed outside the ballpark, it looks like Ted Rogers' statue will be removed. The Rogers statue stands outside Gate 6 of the Rogers Centre and has a contentious history among some Blue Jays fans for its perceived deification of the team's front office.
